title.en: Support for a staff member's family

summary.en: The alumni community and the school together raised ₹3,11,550 for the family of a staff member during a serious illness in 2014.
summary.kn: 2014ರಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಭೀರ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಯ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿರಿಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಸಮುದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಲೆ ಸೇರಿ ₹3,11,550 ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದವು.

archiveNote: This record was first published by the alumni community in an earlier era. Personal and medical detail has been reduced to protect the family concerned; the fact of the campaign and its outcome are unchanged.
